canceled.description: Cancel a scheduled event. Effective only if the original has not been enqueued; after enqueue it becomes a signed retraction request.

scheduled_event_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv4 of the delivery.scheduled event.

scheduled.description: Schedule a sealed event for future release. The sender stores it locally and does not upload before deliver_at. If released late, late_by_seconds records the delay.

inner_event_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv4 of the sealed-to-be event.

late_by_seconds.description: Seconds past deliver_at at release, when the sender was offline at the scheduled time.

description: Delivery payloads: delivery.scheduled, delivery.canceled. The envelope's protected event_type selects the variant.
title: Delivery payloads
